title: Parade Of Buglers Of The Japanese Naval Landing Party To Be Held On April 16

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 9
G. 40M. 1. 36

I.A.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. B. L. 2815
S. 1. Special Branch, Station - 37
REPORT
Date April 14, 1937.

Subject Parade of Buglers of the Japanese Naval Landing Party
to be held on April 16.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

Some 65 members of the Communication Section of the
Japanese Naval Landing Party, Kiangwan Road, will leave the
barracks of the landing party at 8.30 a.m. April 16 and
proceed on foot blowing bugles to the Public Garden via North
Szechuen, Range, Woosun, North Soochow Roads, Garden
Bridge and The Bund. After a short rest in the Garden
they will proceed to Jessfield Park via The Bund, Nanking,
Bubbling Well and Yu Yuen Roads. At about 1 p.m. leaving
the park, they will proceed along Brenan and Robison Roads
to No. 1 and 2 Mills of the Dai Nippon Spinning & Weaving Co., Ltd., from where
they will be transported to the naval landing party, Kiangwan
Road, by motor-truck.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

表格编号 9

I.A.
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 B. L. 2815
S. 1. 特别分部，第37巡捕房
报告
日期：1937年4月14日。

事由：日本海军陆战队号手将于4月16日举行游行。

呈报人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：J. Boyne 副督察长

位于江湾路的日本海军陆战队通讯队约65名队员，将于4月16日上午8时30分离开陆战队营房，徒步吹奏军号，经由北四川路、靶子路（Range Road）、吴淞路、北苏州路、外白渡桥及外滩前往公家花园（Public Garden）。在花园短暂休息后，他们将经由外滩、南京路、静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）及愚园路前往兆丰公园（Jessfield Park）。下午1时许离开公园后，他们将沿倍开尔路（Brenan Road）和罗宾森路（Robison Road）前往大日本纺织株式会社第一、第二纱厂，随后由卡车运送至江湾路海军陆战队驻地。

D. Kamashita
副督察

（批注：因T. Cappeller指出届时交通繁忙，故未实施交通管制）
